title: capsule adapter v2 (replay + separation margin) vs v1 and base

promotion_rule.split: adapter_test (held-out capsule families, never trained on)
promote_if_all: part_count_accuracy >= 0.53 (the base model's accuracy on adapter_test)
paired chamfer_l1 delta vs capsule-v1: upper end of the 95% bootstrap CI <= +0.010 (non-inferior geometry)
paired chamfer_l1 delta vs the base model: upper end of the 95% bootstrap CI < 0 (the capsule gain is kept)
promotion_rule.otherwise: capsule-v1 stays the routed adapter; v2 is reported with its numbers and not used
